skills.name: daily-briefing
skills.description: Research today's developments in technology, digitalisation, data and AI, filter them against this vault, and render an interactive HTML dashboard that opens in a browser without Obsidian. Orders every item by what it changes for this user, extends tracked threads over time, plots marked technologies on a small tech radar, and offers per-item buttons to take an item into the vault as a source note, put it on the watchlist, or mark it as a radar candidate. Use for "daily briefing", "briefing", "was gibt es Neues", "news update", "tech news", "brief mich", "update my briefing", "was ist heute passiert", or when the user wants to be current on their professional topics.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.description: Identifies and removes signs of AI-generated writing from text. Detects inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary, passive voice, negative parallelisms, filler phrases, and more. Makes text sound natural and human-written.

skills.name: ingest
skills.description: One source in, one note out, no dialog. Reads a PDF, Office file, web clip or markdown and writes an OKF note with overview, key statements and a position marker per statement, in 30 seconds to two minutes. Use it when speed beats depth, for inbox capture, image-heavy PDFs, short clips and Office files. Triggers include ingest this, schnell ingesten, nimm das auf, ab in die Inbox, quick ingest, webclip aufnehmen. NOT for a source you want to think through with the user, where the topics get picked and every claim gets a block-level link back into the source: that is ingest-deep. Not for meeting recordings: that is meeting-summary. Not for connecting a note that already exists to the rest of the vault: that is knowledge-link.

skills.name: ingest-deep
skills.description: Deep ingest of one source in a Karpathy-style multi-turn dialog, 5 to 15 minutes. Triage first, then the user picks the topics and the output mode, then block-level links anchor every claim on a verbatim phrase in the source. Produces a sense-making note or several zettel. Handles PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, Markdown, web clips and YouTube videos, including videos whose transcript is not in the page. Use for "ingest deep", "deep dive a source", "sense-making note", "Zettel aus dieser Quelle", "tiefer Ingest", "YouTube-Video ingesten", "Transkript in den Vault". NOT when one note is enough and speed matters, with no questions asked: that is ingest. Not for meeting recordings: that is meeting-summary. Not for connecting a note that already exists to the rest of the vault: that is knowledge-link.

skills.name: interview-insights
skills.description: Summarizes a single qualitative product interview into a citable OKF "interview" note (phase-detected, confirmed before writing). Also synthesizes several named interview notes into a weighted, actionable Insight Report, a team share-out, a Board Dashboard, and one themeable offline HTML Insight Board. Delivers real synthesis (claim + evidence + weight + implication + confidence + uncertainty), not an interview summary; asks at the start for a hypothesis set / business analysis and, if given, adds a Hypothesen view classifying each assumption validiert / falsifiziert / unklar. Asks for the design template first and, for a corporate design, derives colours, font, logo and icons from the real brand assets.

skills.name: knowledge-link
skills.description: Wire an existing note into the knowledge graph. Reads the note, searches the vault for the topics, concepts and people that already have notes, then proposes properties, wikilinks and MOC entries and writes nothing before the user confirms. Creates a stub note only for a hub that earns one, never for a person or a project, where an unresolved link is the intended state. Use after an ingest, or on any note sitting unconnected. Triggers include verdrahte diese Notiz, ins Wissensnetz einhaengen, Notiz einordnen, Properties setzen, verknuepfe die Notiz, link this note, connect it to the graph, place this note. Does NOT ingest sources: a PDF, an Office file or a web clip goes to ingest or ingest-deep first, and this skill picks up the note they produced.

skills.name: meeting-summary
skills.description: Compact summary of a transcript note that stays digestible in under a minute. Strictly on the transcript, no interpretations. Sets block-IDs at key passages and links each statement in the summary discreetly via ↗ symbol to the source passage. Single-note layout (summary on top, transcript below).

skills.name: note-creator
skills.description: Creates new Obsidian notes with content that is always humanized and directly citable (zitierfähig). Triggered whenever the user asks to create, write, or draft a note, document, summary, or any vault content. Enforces the humanizer skill on all generated text before writing to the vault. Handles German umlauts (ö ä ü) correctly. Avoids em dashes and en dashes. Produces natural, human-sounding prose.

skills.name: weekly-meeting-summary
skills.description: Condenses every meeting note of the current week into one compact weekly digest. Writes a new note with key statements, decisions, open points and next steps, ordered by meeting. Trigger phrases: weekly summary, Wochenzusammenfassung Meetings, summarise my meetings, fasse meine Meetings zusammen, weekly meeting digest, Meetings der Woche zusammenfassen, was war diese Woche in meinen Meetings.
